en.html:
—Stopped. The lethal wave had stopped.

Holding back?
...No. At this stage, what mercy would suddenly arrive?

The enemy unit seemed disturbed also. Its camera turned frantically, trying to find the cause of this uninvited development. That was how it looked.

But the enemy unit itself showed nothing wrong—
